why: `std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<Parameter>>` -- what `parameter_map_from_yaml_file` produces. Needs an allocator and `cpp:Parameter`. `rcl_yaml_param_parser` exists to parse a `--params-file` off a FILESYSTEM at node start and hand rcl a tree of overrides. A device image has no filesystem and no YAML parser; parameter defaults are baked into the image at build time (RFC-0045) and changed afterwards over `~/set_parameters`. What a user loses is `--params-file` and everything that reads one.
